title: 了 Step 6 · Which 了? The Big Sort
description: Done, changed, still going, about to, so/too — or no 了 at all? Each sentence needs one decision.

points.title: Where does 了 go?
points.summary: After the verb (done), at the end (changed), both (still going), or nowhere (没, habits, states).
points.body:
Ask: did an action get done? did something change? is it still going? is it a habit or a 没 sentence?

**了 at a glance: done, or changed?**

| | where | means | example |
|---|---|---|---|
| verb-了 | right after the verb | **done** (completed action) | 我买**了**三本书。 |
| sentence-了 | end of the sentence | **changed** (new situation) | 下雨**了**。 我饿**了**。 |
| both | after the verb + at the end | **so far, and still going** | 我学**了**三年中文**了**。 |

**Where 了 does NOT go**
- With 没: 我**没**吃早饭 — never ~~没吃了~~.
- Habits and general states in the past: 我以前**常常**去, 他以前**是**老师, 我小时候**喜欢**画画.
- Plain description: 昨天很冷 — no 了 needed.

**Look-alikes:** 快 / 要 …了 = **about to** (快下雨了); 太…了 = **so / too** (太好了!) — no change involved.

points.title: What does the 了 add?
points.summary: The same words can mean different things depending on 了.
points.body:
- 我不吃 (I don't eat it) vs 我不吃了 (I won't eat any more)
- 我学了三年 (studied three years) vs 我学了三年了 (have been studying three years)

questions.prompt: 了 or no 了? Does the blank need a 了?
items: {我|wǒ}{小时候|xiǎoshíhou}{是|shì}＿{一个|yí ge}{很|hěn}{害羞|hàixiū}{的|de}{孩子|háizi}。
questions.explanation: 了 for **completed actions** and **changes**; none with **没**, **habits** or **states**.
notes: The flowers have come out — a new situation: 开了.
First one action, then the next: 喝了酒就…
A completed action with an amount: 去了一次.
常常 = a habit → no 了.
是 describes a state → no 了.

questions.prompt: The big sort: what is each 了 doing?
questions.explanation: Verb-了 = done · sentence-了 = changed · double 了 + time = still going · 快/要…了 = about to.
notes: Double 了 + a time span: and still learning.

options: I don't eat meat (generally) vs I don't eat meat any more.
Both: I don't eat meat any more.
I won't eat meat vs I didn't eat meat.
notes: Only the second has the change.

questions.prompt: {他|tā}{学|xué}{中文|Zhōngwén}{学|xué}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{年|nián}（　），{现在|xiànzài}{还|hái}{在|zài}{学|xué}。
questions.translation: He's been learning Chinese for two years, and still is.

questions.prompt: Which sentence means 'It's about to get dark'?
'Hurry — the shop is about to close!' Which sentence says so?
questions.translation: Hurry up — the shop's about to close!

questions.explanation: Done (all evening): 下**了**一晚上的雨.
notes: 了 doesn't go before the verb.
questions.translation: It rained all last night, so I didn't go out.

questions.prompt: 'He's been working here for ten years.' Which sentence says so?
notes: That says he hasn't worked here for ten years.
No 了 — sounds like a plan.
questions.translation: He's been working here for ten years.
